notes: Coverage complete: PEMS p.59 (CRITERIA, 8 treatment steps, no MC row) and p.60 (PEARLS, 5 bullets incl. H's and T's) read in full with no truncation. All 8 site rows plus the site Pearls (5 items) compared. Doses verified against PEMS: NS 1 L adult in 250-500 mL boluses; 20 mL/kg peds, max 60 mL/kg; NE 5-20 mcg/min; epi infusion 2-10 mcg/min; peds epi 0.1-1 mcg/kg/min, max 10 mcg/min; SBP targets <1 yr >70 and >1 yr >90; push-dose epi 5-10 mcg q2-3 min. PEMS concentration arithmetic checked: 4 mg/250 mL = 16 mcg/mL; 1 mg/100 mL = 10 mcg/mL; 100 mcg/10 mL = 10 mcg/mL. Site row 2, 3, 4 and 5 and pearls 1-5 match PEMS text except as listed. Level decode: all levels are a bare level token immediately before row text (direct). The PDF could not be checked (NeedsOcrError on pages 47 and 151), so the three CRITICAL items (A2-07, A2-09, A2-11) need a human check of PEMS p.59 in the PDF before developer edits.

notes: MANUAL - no PEMS 2024 source for this protocol; no findings invented. (1) pems_chunks/PEMS2024_full.txt has no 'Aortic Dissection' protocol title. Case-insensitive search for 'aortic|aneurysm' returns one hit only: the PEMS Hypotension & Shock pearl ('Pipe problem: ... such as aortic dissection or pulmonary embolism', p.114). (2) pems_chunks/Aortic_Dissection.txt is a mis-chunk: its content is the PEMS Hypotension and Shock page p.114-115, not an aortic dissection protocol. (3) pems_chunks/protocol_index.json ('Aortic Dissection' -> 'aortic dissection') and mapping.json point at the same Hypotension pearl and mis-chunked file. (4) pems_chunks/ODEMSA_Aortic_Dissection.txt (and .pdf) is the legacy ODEMSA Protocol 2-5 'REVISED 06/2015', not PEMS 2024. The site's own source line cites this ODEMSA 2015 document. (5) The PEMS 2024 PDF cannot be read to confirm (NeedsOcrError: pages 47 and 151 need OCR). Decision needed from a human: confirm whether PEMS 2024 has an Aortic Dissection protocol; if it does, the PEMS text must be supplied; if not, the site protocol's provenance (ODEMSA 2015) must be re-sourced. Non-PEMS observations, not counted: site pearl 6 ('DO NOT administer Aspirin if aortic dissection or AAA is suspected') is broader than the ODEMSA 2015 row 4 wording ('DO NOT administer ASA if acute MI is present in conjunction with suspected AAA or aortic dissection'); site pearls 5, 7, 8, 9 and the site row 11 [A] MC requirement have no counterpart in the ODEMSA 2015 text. The Norepinephrine chart matches the ODEMSA 2015 chart (spot-checked 45-50 kg: 4.50-25.00 mcg/min; 126-130 kg: 12.60-65.00). Level decode: not applicable.
